name: Scrolly
description: Reverse the vertical scroll of your mouse wheel, without touching the trackpad.
author: Giuseppe
details: Reverse the vertical scroll of your mouse wheel without touching the trackpad. A switch in the Control Center: on, the wheel scrolls the other way; the trackpad and horizontal scrolling stay as they are.
features: One switch in the Control Center
permissions: Needs the Accessibility permission, to see and change scroll events.
